∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < r j}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m]) → ∃ (W A : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (D : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (W j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (D j)) ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) (K ∩ {x | r j ≤ f x}) → W j ω = 0) ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (K ∩ {x | r j ≤ f x}) → D j ω = 0) ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m)) (K ∩ {x | r j ≤ f x}) → Z j ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (W 0).boundary ω = D 0 ω - Z 0 ω) ∧ (∀ j (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (W (j + 1)).boundary ω = D (j + 1) ω + Z j ω - Z (j + 1) ω) ∧ (∀ N (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), W j ω = T ω - A N ω) ∧ (W 0).mass = RT.measure {x | r 0 ≤ f x} ∧ (∀ j, (W (j + 1)).mass = RT.measure {x | r (j + 1) ≤ f x ∧ f x < r j}) ∧ (D 0).mass = RB.measure {x | r 0 ≤ f x} ∧ (∀ j, (D (j + 1)).mass = RB.measure {x | r (j + 1) ≤ f x ∧ f x < r j}) ∧ ∀ N, (A N).mass = RT.measure {x | f x < r N}
